Researchers have assessed its condition and theorized its submersion history. stories.summary: Michigan's Reclaim the Rivers initiative is set to invest $89 million to tackle pollution in the Detroit and Kalamazoo rivers. stories.summary: A St. Louis man adopted as a baby nearly 60 years ago discovered that Grammy-winning musician Michael McDonald was his biological father after a previously unknown half-brother took a 23andMe DNA test. The discovery led to meetings with both his birth mother and McDonald, followed by a family reunion that also introduced McDonald to his grandchildren.

57 new deep-sea species discovered in Argentina’s Mar del Plata Canyon, including ‘Loki’ sea cucumber
stories.summary: In a groundbreaking deep-sea voyage off Argentina, scientists uncovered 57 brand new marine species alongside five previously unclassified genera. Using a remotely operated vehicle, they pulled samples from the Mar del Plata Submarine Canyon. Among these marine marvels was a unique and translucent sea cucumber whimsically dubbed Loki. A subsequent collaborative workshop was instrumental in accelerating the species identification process, highlighting the astonishing biodiversity of the South Atlantic's deep ecosystems.

stories.summary: Manickam Tagore, the president of the Tamil Nadu Congress Committee, celebrated the significant inclusion of Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam in the INDIA alliance. The assembly was pivotal in calling for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar due to discrepancies in electoral rolls. Notable participants, Aadhav Arjuna and Maria Wilson, emphasized the urgency of the issue, with protests planned across Tamil Nadu to amplify their demand for accountability.

stories.title: How a US pest-control effort turned Asian lady beetles into an invasive species
stories.summary: Originally imported to the United States for biological pest control, the multicoloured Asian lady beetle, or Harmonia axyridis, has turned invasive. Competing with native ladybugs, this species disrupts ecosystems. While it helps manage aphid populations, its autumn behavior drives adult beetles to invade homes, creating an unwanted nuisance. This case serves as a cautionary tale about the unintended effects of introducing nonnative species into local environments.

stories.title: 'Most comprehensive plan': Ukraine confirms India playing role in mediating energy truce in Black Sea
stories.summary: Ukraine has expressed readiness to explore India's comprehensive proposal for ending the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict. During recent communications, Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha emphasized the importance of India's mediation role. India's external affairs minister S Jaishankar affirmed continuous engagement with both Kyiv and Moscow regarding potential solutions. Ukraine is open to discussing limited ceasefire arrangements around energy infrastructure and safe Black Sea shipping.

A Moroccan mine built a road from phosphate waste rock; field tests cut dust emissions by 91%
stories.summary: In Morocco, a phosphate mine has implemented an innovative road surface made from waste rock generated during phosphate extraction. This robust, three-layered pavement design not only successfully supports heavy mining vehicles but also helps manage dust emissions effectively. Testing resulted in a notable decrease in airborne dust and enhanced road quality, with an anticipated 15 percent boost in productivity for mining operations, while also cutting down maintenance expenses.

The nonprofit not only supplies toys and necessary items to kids facing illness but also encourages community participation, proving that even small gestures can spark tremendous positive impacts.

Delhi landfill garbage mountains shrinking, 100 acres reclaimed in 18 months: CM Rekha Gupta
stories.summary: Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta has reported significant progress in waste management at landfill sites throughout the city. The government has successfully reclaimed land and aims to eliminate existing garbage mountains while managing fresh waste effectively. New waste processing facilities have been inaugurated at Okhla, Ghazipur, and Singhola, each designed to process thousands of metric tonnes daily.

stories.title: Texas family has owned a 650-acre Lake Palestine ranch since 1940; a $10 million deal will turn the property into a new state park
stories.summary: In a strategic move for conservation, a sprawling 650-acre ranch in East Texas is set to transform into a state park. The park’s development will proceed in stages, initially offering guided access before introducing more facilities for visitors.

This mission was executed based on critical intelligence that pinpointed various militant hideouts. Alongside this successful strike, the forces seized a substantial arsenal of weapons and ammunition. This action is a response to the recent surge in violence linked to the TTP, emphasizing the military's ongoing commitment to combatting terrorism in the region.

stories.title: Shopper’s C$5 thrift-store painting turns out to be a David Bowie original, sells for C$108,120
stories.summary: A lucky shopper stumbled upon a remarkable David Bowie painting at a donation center, priced at just C$5. After expert verification, it was revealed to be D Head XLVI from Bowie's iconic Dead Heads series. Shockingly, the artwork was auctioned for an astounding C$108,120, setting a record for Bowie's art. This astonishing find underscores the thrill of discovering hidden gems and the significance of artistic provenance.

He organized the preservation and export of 12,000 piranhas to fund community infrastructure projects. These projects included bridges, a cemetery, a dock, and an airstrip for local residents. stories.title: 658 unmarked graves found at two remote Australian cemeteries after specialist search
stories.summary: A groundbreaking project has identified 658 previously unmarked graves at the White Cliffs and Menindee cemeteries in Australia. Utilizing advanced non-invasive scanning techniques, Hunter Geophysics successfully located these burial sites, ensuring no disturbance to the ground. This initiative aims to enhance cemetery management and heritage conservation, with plans for memorialization at White Cliffs for those honored. stories.summary: In Sherman County, Oregon, a wheat-farming family thrives, thanks to the wind turbines dotting their property. stories.summary: In a landmark decision, the North Carolina Supreme Court has resolved a crucial land dispute involving landowner Elizabeth Mata. stories.title: A Maryland homeowner received an unsolicited $234,368.25 check tied to an offer for her property
stories.summary: Effective October 1, Maryland introduced legislation banning unsolicited checks sent with home purchase offers. This initiative is designed to safeguard homeowners from misleading marketing strategies from property investors. stories.title: BJP government made Haryana number one in drugs, corruption, crime: Hooda
stories.summary: In a passionate speech at the Congress Block Workers' Conference in Tauru, Bhupinder Singh Hooda slammed the BJP government, claiming that under its leadership, Haryana has seen a grave decline in both development and safety. stories.title: Pargat Singh replaces Warring as Punjab Congress chief: Who he is and why Congress chose him
stories.summary: Pargat Singh has been chosen as the new president of the Punjab Pradesh Congress Committee. He replaces Amrinder Singh Raja Warring, who resigned amid party factional tensions. With the 2027 assembly elections approaching, Congress seeks to unify its internal divisions. Singh’s political experience as an MLA and former minister provides valuable legislative insights. stories.summary: Malek Bennouioua, known as maleK and MalekCSGO, has reportedly died at 35. His death was announced by a close friend, while major Counter-Strike figures paid tribute online. stories.summary: The Rooney family has taken a significant step to protect their 57-acre Montana property by establishing a conservation easement. Their deep-rooted connection to this land motivated their choice to maintain its ecological health, ensuring it remains a working property while protecting its natural beauty.

stories.summary: Percival P. Baxter dedicated over thirty years of his life to creating Baxter State Park in Maine, now one of North America's largest state parks. His vision was to maintain the land's natural beauty, thwarting industrial encroachment and promoting sustainable forestry. Though he passed away in 1969, his legacy endures as the park continues to thrive, expanding through land trades and acquisitions to cover over 209,000 acres of pristine wilderness.

He subsequently partnered to acquire land which led to the establishment of family homes. Commencing in 1959, Pratt generously began donating his land for conservation, culminating in the 1972 creation of Guadalupe Mountains National Park. Today, his former residences stand preserved within the park, serving as valuable educational resources.

stories.summary: In Assam, 29-year-old Kalparnab Gupta was apprehended for allegedly sharing inflammatory online content that criticized the Bajrang Dal, RSS, and Hinduism. Consequently, they are considering costlier oil alternatives such as UAE Murban and Iraqi Basrah crude. Additionally, logistical complications have shifted crude flows toward China, potentially decreasing India's dependency on Russian oil alternatives.

stories.summary: Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami has declared the first phase of the Char Dham Yatra a resounding success, with Badrinath and Gangotri attracting unprecedented numbers of visitors this year. He went on to build Rosario mansion and, in 1921, contributed over 2,700 acres to Washington state, establishing Moran State Park, which has grown into a vital recreational space. Robert Moran passed away in 1943, remembered for his lasting influence on conservation in the region.

The confrontation, which occurred early on Sunday morning, stemmed from an argument between several patrons. Detroit Police Chief Todd Bettison confirmed that the three deceased victims were all men. Authorities are actively investigating the case and have received multiple complaints about the venue this year.

stories.title: Charles Baker started garage business for his son in 1980; it has helped 12,500 plus workers
stories.summary: Charles P. Baker III, who died at 101, co-founded Baker Industries with his wife Louise in 1980 after their son struggled to find suitable work. What began as a two-person garage business grew into a workforce development nonprofit that has hired, trained and mentored more than 12,500 people who faced barriers to employment.

stories.summary: In Nepal, heavy rainfall has caused devastating floods and landslides, resulting in 21 lives lost and extensive damage. Authorities have evacuated around 3,000 residents from perilous areas to guarantee their safety. This deluge follows the earlier Bhotekoshi floods, which had a death toll of over 1,400. As rescue efforts continue, landslides have disrupted operations in several districts, and tourists in vulnerable areas are being advised to take precautions.

stories.summary: Six American F-35 fighter jets and over 200 US airmen arrived in Jodhpur to participate in Exercise Tarang Shakti. This exercise features the participation of more than 40 countries and strengthens international cooperation in military operations. US Ambassador Sergio Gor and Indian officials observed a joint demonstration by Indian and US Army personnel. The exercise emphasizes deepening bilateral training and trust among participating nations.

This development follows Iran's earlier announcement regarding another US military drone capture.

The incident occurred while attempting to land in gusty weather at Bengaluru airport. All passengers and crew were safely disembarked, and the aircraft is undergoing maintenance checks. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation is investigating the incident and has engaged with IndiGo regarding pilot training enhancements.

stories.title: Yellowstone rangers remove 20,100 pieces of trash from geothermal areas in 2026
stories.summary: Yellowstone rangers removed more than 20,100 pieces of trash from geothermal areas in 2026, along with over 5,000 rocks and sticks and 280 visitor hats. stories.title: In 2020, a New Jersey man lost his job and began mowing lawns for free; six years later...
stories.summary: After losing his job, Brian Schwartz founded a remarkable volunteer initiative named I Want To Mow Your Lawn. This program offers complimentary lawn care services to seniors, veterans, and others in need. Through a digital platform, volunteers across all 50 states now connect with those requiring assistance, resulting in a thriving community of over 2,000 compassionate participants who collectively enhance the spirit of service and support nationwide.

stories.summary: At WorldSkills Shanghai 2026, India proudly secured the 10th position, reflecting remarkable strides in the global skills competition landscape. The nation earned six silver medals, demonstrating growth in a variety of fields. Significant first-time achievements in Dental Prosthetics and Digital Interactive Media Design were particularly noteworthy. With 70 competitors involved, India's investment in skill development is evident, promoting an enriched skilling ecosystem through global participation.

In 1988, Ohio attorney Neil McKown secretly bought 155 neglected acres; 38 years later...

As the years progressed, the McKown family expanded their land holdings and improved their farming practices. Sam McKown, Neil's son, now manages the farm's daily operations and focuses on quality hay production. The family emphasizes conservation, practicing sustainable land management and engaging with the community.

stories.title: NEET leak fallout: CISF to guard NTA’s confidential exam areas
stories.summary: Responding to the alarming issue of exam paper leaks, the National Testing Agency has fortified its security protocols. A dedicated team of 29 CISF personnel is now assigned to the agency's new office for rigorous oversight. In addition to advancing cybersecurity measures, the NTA is revisiting its entire examination-cycle systems to thwart unauthorized access. Independent audits will also be conducted, aiming for a significant improvement in examination integrity moving forward.

stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government faced backlash after it issued a notification that exempted the Public (Law and Order) Department from the Right to Information (RTI) Act. Critics, including numerous political leaders, argued that such an action would jeopardize transparency and obstruct public access to crucial law records. In response to widespread criticism, the government promptly withdrew the exemption, reaffirming its commitment to uphold the RTI Act.

She now runs FarmerJawn Agriculture, a 128-acre Black-owned farm in West Chester, Pennsylvania, and employs 26 people. Her operation also has urban and suburban locations, with CornerJawn, a food and medicine store in Kensington, scheduled to open on October 1.

Residents of the nearby village of Whelford were evacuated to a leisure center in Cirencester. In 2024, Iowa farmer Evie Haupt earned $35,000 yearly from 3 turbines, cutting debt to $67,000
stories.summary: Evie Haupt, an Iowa farmer, has notably increased her revenue by leasing land for wind turbines. This extra income has been instrumental in alleviating her farm debts following her husband's passing. Even though the turbines occupy less than an acre, she continues her traditional farming practices on the bulk of her land. The rise of wind power is transforming the financial prospects for rural landowners nationwide.

stories.title: 14-year-old Jia Mingxuan builds tree-saving device that wins gold in Germany
stories.summary: At 14, Jia Mingxuan turned a childhood view of Aohan’s dry landscape into a simple device designed to capture atmospheric moisture for young trees. Built from steel tubes and recycled plastic bottles, his prototype uses condensation to direct water towards sapling roots. The invention won gold at the 2025 Nuremberg International Invention Exhibition.

stories.title: Goulburn’s 300 local investors funded a 1.4MW solar farm and 4MWh battery over 12 years
stories.summary: Residents of Goulburn embarked on an inspiring decade-long endeavor to establish a community-driven solar farm alongside a battery system. With the backing of about 300 local investors, they overcame significant obstacles such as regulatory hurdles and supply chain challenges. Ultimately, the solar farm commenced operations, contributing clean energy to the local grid, and stands as an exemplary model for community-led renewable energy initiatives throughout regional Australia.

A Minnesota family farm was sold after receiving approval to be turned into a 262-home community
stories.summary: Heavy machinery has begun grading the former Vierling family farm in Minnesota for a new housing development. The Prior Lake City Council recently approved the plans for the 262-home neighborhood named Vierling Ridge. Pulte Homes aims to complete the main infrastructure by autumn, allowing construction to begin in winter. Various housing styles are planned, catering to different demographics and needs. The entire project is expected to be completed by 2032.

stories.title: Trump-Xi bonhomie set to continue, leaders announce two more meetings
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping have agreed to meet in November and December. They will hold talks in China and at the G20 summit in Miami. These meetings aim to strengthen the relationship between the two largest economies. However, their recent discussions did not result in significant breakthroughs on various issues. Xi's visit included a state dinner and cultural exchanges during China's Mid-Autumn Festival.

stories.title: At age 6, Grace opened a lemonade stand hoping to raise $10, seven summers later, she made $55,000
stories.summary: Grace Hendrian and her sister June initiated their Lemon-Aid Stand for Good in 2019 to support charity. They aimed to raise $10 but ultimately collected $55,000 for The Salvation Army. Their project encouraged community participation, leading to 14 stands operating by 2026. The sisters received recognition for their volunteer efforts as they also contributed to local families in need. Their fundraising initiative concluded in 2026, marking its final season.

170 volunteers remove 43,000 pounds of trash from San Antonio dumping site after years of complaints
stories.summary: Around 170 volunteers have removed 43,000 pounds of trash from a long-standing dumping site outside Converse in Bexar County. The property had previously been used as an encampment and had drawn years of complaints. The county initially received a $100,000 cleanup estimate before River Aid San Antonio organized volunteer efforts. A final cleanup is planned for November 7.

stories.title: A Seattle shipbuilder sold his company for $3.5 million in 1906 and built an Orcas Island estate
stories.summary: Robert Moran established a thriving shipbuilding enterprise before shifting his focus to cultivate a serene habitat on Orcas Island. Upon receiving a terminal diagnosis, he chose to embrace the beauty of nature and safeguard the area. He generously donated land for what would become Moran State Park, a gift that would enhance public enjoyment, especially during the Great Depression. His legacy persists in fostering community engagement and conserving the environment.

stories.title: Pakistan goes bananas over giant gorillas dancing to Bollywood songs
stories.summary: In Lahore, a vibrant new trend has emerged where massive gorillas are stealing the spotlight at weddings and celebrations. The concept, launched by Shayen Zahoor after receiving a gorilla costume in April, quickly captured attention on Instagram, amassing over a million views in just two days. This phenomenon led to a surge in event bookings, making these giant gorillas a delightful and unmistakable presence at gatherings across Pakistan.

Floating solar cuts seabed light in French Polynesia, with no detectable lagoon temperature
stories.summary: Floating photovoltaic platforms in a French Polynesian lagoon created substantial reductions in light reaching the seabed, which was studied for one year. Researchers monitored the environmental impact of four platforms and a control area during the study. They observed strong attenuation in ultraviolet radiation under the platforms, affecting diverse wavelengths. However, changes in water temperature remained statistically insignificant and below sensor accuracy levels.

stories.title: An Italian town is rebuilding its school with 70% of the old building's demolition waste
stories.summary: A new primary school is being built in Castel Madama with a strong focus on sustainability and the use of reusable materials. About 70% of the waste from the existing school will be redirected to this project, promoting a circular economy. Designed with community needs in mind, the school will provide spaces for social and educational activities after hours. Accessibility is a priority, ensuring that all individuals can benefit.
